description: We’re Team Path Finder: space enthusiasts building AetherX, a free tool that opens NASA’s SPHEREx sky to everyone and turns the search for Planet Nine into something anyone can join. Our team is full for now. Thanks, and clear skies!
summary: AetherX is an interactive astronomical discovery platform for investigating stars, planets, and possible Planet Nine scenarios. It combines NASA and open astronomy datasets with Aladin sky visualization, case files, planted-planet experiments, fake-planet simulations, and an autonomous AI agent with more than 30 tools. Users can explore how deeply available observations can reveal objects, compare evidence, and build explainable astronomical investigations.
details:
AetherX transforms complex astronomical data into an accessible investigation workspace. Users can search and inspect celestial objects, view multi-wavelength sky surveys through Aladin, create case files, and simulate planted or hypothetical planets to test how detectable they would be at different distances and observation conditions.

The platform combines SPHEREx/IRSA, Gaia DR3, WISE, CatWISE2020, CDS catalogs, JPL Horizons/SBIdent, Aladin surveys, and other astronomy resources. The planted-planet and fake-planet simulation features help users understand how far an object can be detected and what evidence would be visible at different distances.

AetherX also includes an autonomous AI agent that can operate more than 30 tools for data retrieval, astronomical analysis, visualization, investigation workflows, and report generation after a task is initiated. The project was developed using TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node.js, APIs, astronomy data services, and interactive visualization components.
